newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 index sets record in pre-market.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 index sets record in pre-market.

text.p: The UK stock market continued its record-breaking run on Monday after scaling new highs on Friday when surprisingly weak U.S. employment data allayed fears of interest rate rises in the U.S.

The FTSE 100 share index hit a record 4,025.4 points in pre-market dealings, up 0.6 point on the day and surpassing the previous all-time high of 4,025.1 points set on Friday when Wall Street and debt markets soared after the jobs data.
Investors worldwide cheered the data, believing it would deter the U.S. Federal Reserve from a long-feared tightening of monetary policy in the U.S.
